title: Postdoctoral researcher in experimental robotics and AI for autonomous battery remanufacturing
about: Postdoc in the Department of Electrical Engineering on an industrial robotic system that autonomously manufactures, tests, analyses, disassembles, cleans and remanufactures Li-ion battery cells.
requirements: PhD (or foreign equivalent) in electrical engineering, chemical engineering, engineering physics or similar, obtained by the employment decision
Practical experience in automation/robotics or battery chemistry

upskill.name: Robotics & Autonomous Systems I
why: "Practical experience in automation/robotics" (qualification) → "Motion planning and control: trajectory optimisation, model-predictive control"

"industrial robotic system that autonomously ... disassembles, cleans and remanufactures Li-ion battery cells" (description) → "Manipulation: dexterous grasping, object interaction, learning from demonstration"; the course does not cover battery chemistry
